svg.title: News filter decisions
svg.desc: An article already stored is skipped. Otherwise non-bank phrases are masked; an article naming no bank is rejected; a duplicate is rejected, unless the article has full text and the only earlier copy is a bare headline; otherwise it is kept, with flags for masked phrases and possible bank commentary.
